title: Autonomous excited-state investigation of carbazole Bpin positional isomers
difficulty_reasons: The agent must choose and justify computational models, geometry/state candidates and hypothesis discrimination for three isomers.
Search coverage, validation and stopping must be defended while preserving per-candidate identity and failure context.

paper.title: Breaking the lifetime-efficiency trade-off in blue organic room-temperature phosphorescence through site-directed boronate engineering

data.description: Explicit names, positional identities, formulae, neutral singlet state and PVA boundary for CZ1B/CZ2B/CZ4B. CCDC identifiers are provenance only; no CIF or database retrieval is required or scored.

required_deliverables.description: Search plan, per-candidate validation and observables, hypothesis discrimination, computed cross-isomer comparison (experimental lifetime comparison is evaluator-private) and limitations.
